skills.name: Barrier - Blunt Stance - Bl.

fx.raw: Give a Barrier to all party members with 7.5% \ 15% \ 22.5% \ 30% damage reduction (1 time)

skills.desc:
When in Roaring Bash Stance: Give a Barrier to all party members with 7.5% \ 15% \ 22.5% \ 30% damage reduction (1 time)
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 ) of Blunt moves used during the turn.
** double moves from Copy status are counted twice. Attack again moves are each counted.
** End-of-Turn, counters, knocked back or dead allies' moves are not counted.
** Counting Rules - in-length explanations
